payload.text: opinion_change(s | reward=1) > opinion_change(s | reward=20) >= opinion_change(s | control)

text_anchor.verbatimQuote: In short, when an S was induced, by offer of reward, to say something contrary to his private opinion, this private opinion tended to change so as to correspond more closely with what he had said. The greater the reward offered (beyond what was necessary to elicit the behavior) the smaller was the effect.
